Hi Jordan 

Great to meet you and Chris on the call today  thanks for walking through how Orion ingests customer logs and the SLA needs for inference latency (p95 < 250ms on interactive queries). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Problem: real-time anomaly detection requires low-latency embeddings + reranking; spikes during end-of-month reporting are the primary capacity stress.
- What we heard: can start with a 3-week pilot on a single team (30k requests/day avg, 150k peaking) and evaluate cost/latency.
- Constraints: security team will need SOC 2 evidence and basic network restrictions (VPC peering).

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a short technical brief and a preliminary pricing estimate (attached).
2) Marissa (cc) can connect on pilot onboarding and can share a sample MOP (mutual action plan) if you want to move forward.
3) If security is required before we start, we can schedule a 30-min call between our security SMEs next week.

Questions for you:
- Does the pilot timeline (3 weeks, starting mid-May) look feasible on your side?
- Who on your security team should we loop in for the evidence request?

Attachments: redwood-technical-brief.pdf, redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx

Thanks  happy to jump on another call if it helps.
